versions.content: The Bus Mirroring module shall evaluate the status reported by Mirror_ReportLinFrame . If it is LIN_TX_HEADER_ERROR , LIN_TX_ERROR , LIN_RX_ERROR , or LIN_RX_NO_RESPONSE , the reported LIN source bus state shall be set to header transmission error, transmission error, reception error, or no re- sponse.

The Bus Mirroring module shall evaluate the status reported by Mirror_ReportLinFrame . If it is LIN_TX_HEADER_ERROR , LIN_TX_ERROR , LIN_RX_ERROR , or LIN_RX_NO_RESPONSE , the reported LIN source bus state shall be set to header transmission error, transmission error, reception error, or no re- sponse.

The Bus Mirroring module shall evaluate the status reported by Mirror_ReportLinFrame . If it is LIN_TX_HEADER_ERROR , LIN_TX_ERROR , LIN_RX_ERROR , or LIN_RX_NO_RESPONSE , the reported LIN source bus state shall be set to header transmission error, transmission error, reception error, or no re- sponse.

The Bus Mirroring module shall evaluate the status reported by Mirror_ReportLinFrame . If it is LIN_TX_HEADER_ERROR , LIN_TX_ERROR , LIN_RX_ERROR , or LIN_RX_NO_RESPONSE , the reported LIN source bus state shall be set to header transmission error, transmission error, reception error, or no re- sponse.
